_comment: Canonical D5 fixture for /demos/multimodal. The sample buttons attach the bundled sample.png and sample.pdf and auto-send the exact prompts below. Responses describe the checked-in assets; prompt-based fixture selection alone does not prove attachment transport.

match.userMessage: can you tell me what is in this demo image I just attached

response.content: The attached image is the CopilotKit logo — a clean, geometric mark used across CopilotKit branding.

match.userMessage: can you tell me what is in this demo pdf I just attached

response.content: The attached PDF document is the CopilotKit Quickstart guide. It walks through installing the React packages, configuring the CopilotKit provider, and adding a CopilotKit chat component to an application.
